name: combobox
title: Combobox
description: Picks one or more values from a long list by typing to filter it, then Apply.

props.name: footer
props.description: Cancel and Apply under the list; picks apply only with Apply.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while nothing is picked. Defaults to the `select` label ("Select…").

props.name: searchPlaceholder
props.description: The query field's placeholder and name. Defaults to the `search` label.

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when nothing matches the query. Defaults to the `noResults` label.

props.name: creatable
props.description: Offer a `Create "…"` row at the end of the list while the query matches no option exactly. `label` words the row (default: the `createOption` label, which also names it for screen readers).

props.name: onCreate
props.description: Makes the option for a query from the create row (trimmed). Return it, or a promise of it: the row shows a Spinner until it settles, and a rejection (or a throw) shows the `createFailed` label under the row. The option is added to the list and picked; it stays while the Combobox is mounted, so add it to `options` to keep it. Left out, the option is `{ value: query, label: query }`.

props.name: onOpenAutoFocus
props.description: Keep focus where it is when the panel opens (inline previews).

props.name: onInteractOutside
props.description: A press outside the panel; `preventDefault()` keeps it open.
